name: Westchester County Summer Programs (YMCA of Central and Northern Westchester)
operator_name: YMCA of Central and Northern Westchester
description_short: Six week YMCA summer day program for children entering grades 1 to 5 (Big Kid Summer), held at the White Plains YMCA and in Valhalla, with weekly themes, sports, science lessons, special visitors and field trips. A Pee Wee program for the Y's own UPK students also runs at these sites and at French Hill School in Yorktown Heights.
notes: Weekly rate $440 for 8 am to 4 pm, $480 for 8 am to 6 pm. Locations: White Plains YMCA, 148 Hamilton Ave (Pee Wee and Big Kid); 2 Broadway, Valhalla (Pee Wee and Big Kid); French Hill School, 2051 Baldwin Rd, Yorktown Heights (Pee Wee only, for Yorktown, Lakeland, Mahopac, North Salem, Putnam Valley and Somers families). Pee Wee Summer is only for YMCA UPK students of the 2025 to 2026 or 2026 to 2027 school years.
